subclass.name: Gunslinger
subclass._lore:
Most fighters spend their years perfecting swordplay, archery or the polearm. A few went the other way: alchemical powder, rare metals and controlled explosive force, and the nerve to stand behind the result. A gunslinger is a distant and very sudden kind of death — when the weapon works.

This is the free Gunslinger martial archetype by Matt Mercer (Gunslinger 1.3, art by Nick Robles), published under the DMs Guild Community Content Agreement. Its rules are summarised here for play at this table.

subclassFeature.name: Firearm Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with firearms, and add your proficiency bonus to attacks made with them.

subclassFeature.name: Gunsmith
entries: You gain proficiency with tinker's tools. With them you craft ammunition at half cost, repair damaged firearms, and — at your GM's discretion — draft and build new ones. The strangest firearms exist only as something somebody built.

subclassFeature.name: Adept Marksman
entries: You learn to perform trick shots with your firearms, to disable or to damage.

entries.name: Trick Shots
entries: You learn two trick shots of your choice from the list below, and another at levels 7, 10, 15 and 18. Each time you learn one you may also swap one you already know.
A trick shot must be declared before the attack roll, and only one may be used per attack.

entries.name: Grit
entries: You have a number of grit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). You regain one grit point when you roll a 20 on the d20 for a firearm attack, or when you deal a killing blow with a firearm to a creature of significant threat. All spent grit returns on a short or long rest.

entries.name: Saving Throws
entries: Trick shot save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Bullying Shot
entries: Spend 1 grit to gain Advantage on a Charisma (Intimidation) check, using the blast and the noise to shake them.

entries.name: Dazing Shot
entries: Spend 1 grit on a firearm attack. On a hit, normal damage, and the target makes a Constitution save or attacks at Disadvantage until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Deadeye Shot
entries: Spend 1 grit to gain Advantage on the attack roll.

entries.name: Disarming Shot
entries: Spend 1 grit on a firearm attack. On a hit, normal damage, and the target makes a Strength save or drops one held object of your choice, which is pushed 10 feet away from you.

entries.name: Forceful Shot
entries: Spend 1 grit on a firearm attack. On a hit, normal damage, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 15 feet away from you.

entries.name: Piercing Shot
entries: Spend 1 grit on a firearm attack, raising its misfire score by 1. On a hit, normal damage, and you roll an attack with Disadvantage against every creature in a line behind the target within your first range increment. Only the first attack can misfire.

entries.name: Violent Shot
entries: Spend one or more grit on a firearm attack, raising its misfire score by 2 for each point spent. On a hit, roll one extra weapon damage die per point spent.

entries.name: Winging Shot
entries: Spend 1 grit on a firearm attack. On a hit, normal damage, and the target makes a Strength save or is knocked prone.

subclassFeature.name: Quickdraw
entries: You add your proficiency bonus to initiative, and can stow a firearm and draw another as a single object interaction on your turn.

subclassFeature.name: Rapid Repair
entries: You can spend a grit point to repair a misfired — but not broken — firearm as a bonus action.

subclassFeature.name: Lightning Reload
entries: You can reload any firearm as a bonus action.

subclassFeature.name: Vicious Intent
entries: Your firearm attacks score a critical hit on a 19 or 20, and you regain a grit point whenever you roll a 19 or 20 on a d20 firearm attack roll.

subclassFeature.name: Hemorrhaging Critical
entries: When you score a critical hit with a firearm, the target takes half the attack's damage again at the end of its next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Firearms and their properties
entries: Firearms are ranged weapons with properties of their own, which replace the optional firearm rules in the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Reload
entries: The weapon fires a number of times equal to its reload score before you must spend one attack or one action reloading it, with a free hand.

entries.name: Misfire
entries: If the d20 for a firearm attack rolls equal to or under the weapon's misfire score, the attack misses and the weapon cannot be used again until you spend an action repairing it with a tinker's tools check (DC 8 + misfire score). Fail that check and the weapon is broken, mended out of combat for a quarter of its cost.
A creature with no proficiency in firearms raises the weapon's misfire score by 1.

entries.name: Explosive
entries: On a hit, everything within 5 feet of the target makes a Dexterity save (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier) or takes 1d8 fire damage. On a miss the round fails to detonate.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: Every firearm needs its own ammunition, which is rare enough that it is usually crafted rather than bought — at half cost with tinker's tools.
